capabilities: Open Google NotebookLM in an embedded side-panel view
Send the active note or selected text as a NotebookLM source
Choose an existing notebook or create a new one when sending
Include or exclude metadata and frontmatter in transferred sources
Trigger transfers via ribbon icons, context menus, or commands
extras: Desktop-only because it uses desktop-only APIs. The listing notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. The README states the plugin collects no telemetry and only sends content when the user chooses to transfer notes.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to push notes into Google NotebookLM, requiring manual copy-paste or browser switching.

relations.evidence: Send notes directly to Google NotebookLM as sources from an embedded NotebookLM view.

summary: Embeds Google NotebookLM in a side-panel view and sends the active note or selected text to it as NotebookLM sources.
